title: Dialogue with the Machine and Dialogue with the Art World: Evaluating Generative AI for Culturally-Situated Creativity

bias_targets.methodology: A qualitative dialogic evaluation method involving structured artistic experimentation with generative AI tools ('dialogue with the machine') and reflective workshops with artists, cultural experts, historians, and curators ('dialogue with the art world') to assess cultural representation, historical accuracy, and the presence of orientalist tropes in generated outputs (specifically focusing on the Persian Gulf and Iranian culture).
